Bund16 台湾银行旧址 / modern 招商银行

method: All three full original JPEGs were actually inspected with view_image. Counts are photographic observations, not measured architectural drawings. A P02 crop resolved round-column/engaged-column shaft count. No unseen elevation is asserted complete.

principal_floors.scope: Visible historic street elevations; interior subdivision and rear additions not established. OSM building:levels=5 is preserved as a conflicting raw tag, not converted into five facade floors.

front.photo_mapping: Eastern / river-facing main elevation, primarily OSM edge17; oblique wing at south end is separate from the main five-part front.

ground_openings.observed_relationship: Two broader outer arches and two narrower inner arches; central rectangular stone portal projects and carries floor2 balcony. P02 has arched glazed recess behind the portal; P01 shows a changed/obscured recess so current internal door geometry needs calibration rather than copying 2013 shop glazing.

upper_loggias.current_status: P01 supports retained loggia organization, while several rear openings are hidden by oblique projection and columns; all seven contemporary window states are not independently verified.
upper_loggias.geometry_requirement: Two planes: real open external colonnade and a recessed red-brick wall with true arched apertures. Balustrade is porous individual balusters with continuous top rail. Do not flatten porch voids into a painted wall.

upper_columns.central_organization: Four paired supports framing three central spans
upper_columns.confidence: High for visible positions; profile and full-round versus engaged boundary shafts need later calibration.
upper_columns.qualification: Some shafts touch brick piers. This is not a claim of 12 fully freestanding columns. Earlier coarse count of 10 is superseded.

column_orders.floor2: Tuscan, official H01; visually plain capitals
column_orders.floor3: Corinthian, official H01; visible leafy capitals

visible_features: Raised shield/oval centre with foliate scroll relief in both end pediments
Continuous decorated cornice frieze and dentil/modillion row
Gray tiled sloping roof behind front pediments
Higher rear parapet/roof-access strip and flagpole visible in P01, full roof plan unavailable
Balcony over central projecting entrance; pediment-like crest on each outer floor2 balustrade panel
Gold circled company logo on central frieze in P01, absent on P02
roof_and_ornament.limitations: Relief contours are visible, not measured; model these as informed approximate relief, not exact laser-scan ornament.

north.orientation: North-facing / Fuzhou Road side, photo-right of eastern front
north.roof_observation: Three small gabled/dormer-like structures on the north roof slope; centre has a round opening and taller decorative terminal. They are not the two eastern main-front pediments.
occlusion: Ground right/rear opening partly blocked by vegetation
Banners and road equipment obscure ground glazing and lower sills
Far rear wall and attached west structures incomplete
north.limits: 2013 observation only; no 2025 north-side photograph in the source set confirms unchanged dormers or glazing. Do not claim complete rear wall or merge adjacent west building from this perspective.

south.visible: Two clearly distinguishable upper arched axes on the short oblique/stepped southern return, with additional partial arch fragments further west behind trees.
south.unresolved: Complete southern and western opening counts, ground aperture shapes behind the trees, precise correspondence of each return face to OSM small segments.
occlusion: Tree crowns and trunks cover much of sidewall
south.rule: Do not extrapolate two visible return windows to a complete two-axis south elevation or fill unseen facade with invented repeated windows.

subsequent_detail_review.source: P01 actually viewed at original resolution plus named inspection crops

short_east_facing_wing.floor2_grid_pattern: Top3 rows, thick transom, lower4 rows

rounded_return.evidence: Upper arched window visible in2025 crop between short east-facing wing and south-facing wall
rounded_return.geometry_caveat: Exact window plane through source rounded facets is not surveyed. Model uses retained wall facets and an estimated flat inset frame chord.

south_facing_straight_return.occlusion: Both crowns partly visible behind tree, lower aperture outlines incomplete; geometry below flagged inferred.

unmeasured: Roof pitches and concealed roof geometry
future_calibration: Use frozen footprint scale with perspective-aware photograph matching. Label proportional heights/depths and unseen closures as approximations. Never use OSM levels*default-storey-height to claim a surveyed height.
temporal_limit: Newest source photograph is 2025-05-01. This research makes no claim of a 2026 inspection.
